plan.major: Teaching, Schools and Society: Teaching, Schools and Social Sciences Concentration
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Teaching, Schools and Society Major (BA) program page (poid=898), Teaching, Schools and Social Sciences concentration. Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The introduction states that students select a concentration within the major; the two concentrations are collected as two plans sharing the printed 'Core Courses for all TSS Concentrations' block. The introduction also states that students can pursue a licensure curriculum of professional studies courses '(listed below the major itself)', but no such list appears on the program page, which ends after the Social Sciences concentration; nothing beyond the printed major blocks is collected. No heading on the page prints an hour subtotal and no total is printed; the recorded total is the exact itemized sum at the values stated in these notes. EDUC 112's title is truncated as printed ('Historic and Social Foundations of Educ') on both the program page and its course detail page. The recorded total (33) is the exact itemized sum: the shared core at 12, the six fixed concentration courses at 18, and the POLI 100-or-120 choice slot at 3. No fixed course in this plan prints a prerequisite line.
